---
title: "ocel env sync"
description: "Read the env source a tier's last deploy registered into its values now."
---

```bash
ocel env sync [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--preview` | `bool` | `false` | Use preview values |

Every command also takes the [global flags](/docs/cli#global-flags).

## Behaviour

- Changes state.
- Prints data on stdout.
